subject: Deal plan recap, MAP draft, and request for exec credit approval
messages:
From: Samuel Evans <samuel.evans@clearlake.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearlake.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap from today — next steps + MAP request

Rachel — thanks again for today's demo and walkthrough. Thought it would help to capture the key points we discussed and ask for a draft Mutual Action Plan we can use internally. High-level notes: 
- Primary use: query and financial-report summarization for our client advisors (latency SLO ~200ms typical).
- Target initial scope: 35M tokens/month across US region; spike tolerance for quarter-end reporting.
- Security: SOC2 plus VPC peering; we'll need logs retention details for compliance team.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency <250ms at baseline traffic, monthly cost target under our procurement threshold.

Can you send a short MAP that lists milestones, owners, target close date, and any dependencies? Also, Procurement will need a preliminary pricing worksheet and any notes on volume commitment to evaluate discounts. I'm looping them in.

Thanks — I'll coordinate internal calendar for a decision review next week.

—Sam
Samuel Evans
VP, Engineering
ClearLake Financial
Phone: +1 415-555-0174

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samuel Evans <samuel.evans@clearlake.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearlake.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today — next steps + MAP request

Sam — great to meet you and the crew yesterday. Appreciate the clear criteria. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan and a draft SOW. Highlights (TL;DR):

- MAP milestones (owner / ETA):
  1) Security review kickoff — ClearLake / Redwood (Samuel / Rachel) — 2026-12-03
  2) Proof-of-concept (2-week) environment — Redwood (eng delivery) — 2026-12-10
  3) Performance tuning & pilot test — ClearLake + Redwood — 2026-12-24
  4) Contract signature & initial commit — ClearLake Legal / Redwood Sales — target 2027-01-07

- Dependencies: VPC peering setup (networking), KMS integration for keys, SOC2 evidence package (we can provide), and initial commit level to qualify for tiered pricing.

- Pricing / discounts: Attached worksheet shows list price, volume tiers, and the baseline example for 35M tokens/month. To move pricing materially (credit/discount), we'll need a committed monthly spend level or a 12-month revenue commit. Ben is looped for an internal pricing approval path — Ben, can you advise on what level of commit unlocks a 15% discount vs. a one-time onboarding credit?

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_ClearLake_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_ClearLake_draft.pdf (SOW draft)

Next steps I propose:
1) I update the MAP per any change requests from your team by 2026-12-01.
2) Procurement to confirm required procurement documents and target decision window.
3) If pricing needs exec approval, we'll escalate with an ask and proposed credit/commit scenarios.

I'll prep an internal approval note and cc Ben for the pricing path.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
Mobile: +1 650-555-3882

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:23:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft for ClearLake — request for exec credit/discount approval

Markus — forwarding the ClearLake thread and MAP draft. Quick summary and ask:
- Account: ClearLake Financial (enterprise prospect).
- Ask from procurement: Price review to fit their internal threshold. They are showing 35M tokens/mo baseline with seasonality.
- We're proposing two options in the attached pricing worksheet:
  A) 12-month commit at X tokens/month => 15% discount + $50k onboarding credit (requires exec signoff)
  B) Quarterly commit with pilot pricing => 7% discount, no onboarding credit (can approve at AE/Manager level)

They've requested a target contract signature by 2027-01-07 to align with their budget cycle. Security review and VPC peering are non-blocking but need documentation.

Can you approve option A as an exception for onboarding credit if we get verbal commitment to the 12-month revenue? If you need a tighter guardrail, I'm happy to propose a $30k credit and 12-month commit with a minimum monthly baseline.

I'm attaching the MAP and the pricing worksheet. Rachel — FYI, procurement mentioned they will run the numbers by Monday and expect a summary to finance.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com

[Attachment stubs: Mutual_Action_Plan_ClearLake_v1.xlsx, Pricing_Worksheet_ClearLake_v1.csv]
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft for ClearLake — request for exec credit/discount approval

Ben / Rachel — thanks for the concise ask. I reviewed the MAP and the proposed pricing scenarios. Approve conditional exception:

- We can approve option A with a $40k one-time onboarding credit (reduced from $50k) if the customer signs a 12-month commit with a minimum monthly spend equal to the 35M token baseline.
- Credit will be tied to executed contract and paid out on invoice #1.
- Require legal to insert a minimum commitment clause and a 60-day review window for usage deviations.

Please confirm the exact commit numbers and we'll route to Finance for a final sign-off. Rachel — once you get a verbal commitment, send me the updated HubSpot deal link and final pricing sheet; I'll ask Finance to clear the exception.

Markus Klein
VP, Global Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199
